svg.title: Four-hour halvings and finite exposure
svg.desc: A fictional one-compartment concentration–time curve starts at 100 ng/mL and halves every four hours: 50 at four hours, 25 at eight and 12.5 at twelve. Linear axes identify hours and concentration. The shaded area is exposure only from zero to twelve hours, not dose or biological effect. Four markers are model values, not observed samples. The finite model integral is 350 divided by ln(2), approximately 504.943 ng·h/mL over 0–12 hours. No treatment recommendation is represented.

g.text: One analyte · Model values, not samples
